title: prefer undo or popconfirm over modal
rule: Prefer undo (or Popconfirm) over Modal double-confirm — delete → success + Undo (message+undo gone after one minute or on Undo). If undo is invalid, use Popconfirm next to the control. Abusing Modal drops context and blocks undo. Dual-cite Primer "never warning when you mean undo" / NN/g undo; Ant names Popconfirm vs Modal.
pass_when: Delete uses success + Undo (gone after one minute or on Undo), or Popconfirm next to the control when undo is invalid — not a blocking Modal when undo would work.
fail_when: Modal double-confirm used where undo is valid; or no undo/Popconfirm on that delete.
overview: Prefer Undo or Popconfirm for delete; avoid Modal double-confirm when undo works.
apply_when: Protecting a delete or similar reversible destructive action.
not_when: Irreversible high-stakes commits where undo is truly invalid by design.
agent_hint: After delete, offer success plus Undo, or Popconfirm beside the control.
description: Ant prefers undo (or Popconfirm) over a blocking Modal double-confirm. Delete should surface success with Undo (message and undo gone after one minute or on Undo); when undo is invalid, place Popconfirm next to the control. Abusing Modal drops context and blocks undo. Dual-cite Primer/NN/g undo guidance; Ant names Popconfirm versus Modal. Fail Modal double-confirm where undo is valid, or delete with neither undo nor Popconfirm.
do_not_claim: Deleting `actions.confirm.serious_or_undo`; a house one-minute as law outside this cite. Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.confirm.serious_or_undo`. Overlap with extra 73: `nng.support-undo-discoverable`.
